Join a global community
International students make up 30 percent of Dalhousie University’s community, with students from nearly 100 countries around the world who now call Nova Scotia home. We’re glad you are exploring Dalhousie to continue your studies. If you have questions about study permits and transitioning to life in Canada, Dalhousie’s International Centre can answer all of your questions.
Application deadlines
As an international student you will need to ensure you apply by the earlier deadlines established for non-Canadian citizens. You will find these deadlines on our How to Apply page.
Information for your student visa
If you’re accepted to your program, you will require a letter from the Faculty of Graduate Studies confirming your acceptance to obtain a student visa. This letter will be provided to you as part of the acceptance process. For your visa application, you will also require Dalhousie University’s Designated Learning Institution number which is issued by the Government of Canada. Dalhousie’s number is # O19209939282.
English language proficiency
If English is an additional language for you, you may be required to pass a designated course or examination to establish your ability to study at an advanced level in the language.
